siteSource: docs/LUNAR_ADDITIONAL_SITES_RESEARCH.md catalog row 1 (DM1), NASA Lunar Surface Data Book M2M-30044 Table A2.1-1. Center of an original candidate-region polygon; not an approved landing site.

featureNotes.ridge: Highest source pixel within 250 m of the sampled skyline at grid bearing 284 degrees from the site: the eastern rim of a roughly 1 km crater, about 2.57 km from the site and 270 m above it. Descriptive label from numeric DM1 elevation and illustrative hillshade; not an IAU feature name.
featureNotes.third: Off-grid holdout on the slope that descends toward the Amundsen crater interior (grid south); no mission significance.
featureNotes.nearDetail: Gentlest 25 m window (about 1 degree plane-fit slope) within 45 m of the saved point, about 21 m from it. Selected for scale-figure footing, not landing suitability.
featureNotes.crop: Shifted 2.5 km grid-west of the saved point so that the higher west-southwest terrain crest seen from the viewpoint lies inside the crop instead of at its boundary.

siteLimitations: The saved point lies on a broad, gently undulating crest; the 10 km crop does not include the complete Amundsen crater or its floor.
The astronaut stands on a gently sloping triangle selected for footing; no claim of walkability, safe footing or landing suitability.
